title: The TEAL Method: How to Tailor Your Resume (& Get the Job You Want)
description:

Here's how to get set up and make the most of the tools for your search. 

Have thoughts, suggestions, or feedback about what would be most helpful in these videos? Leave a comment or email us (membersupport@tealhq.com).
